summary: Made SLA escalation deadline selection aware of first response completion and bounded escalation to one conditional claim per ticket.

Added deterministic rule selection, target validation, missing assignment target checks, compare-and-set writes, and a Prisma transaction that atomically claims escalation routing with its audit event.
Added fail-closed unknown-role behavior at helper and route boundaries, including inherited-key defenses, with twenty focused tests across seven files
Added nine portable source-grounded upskill chapters with complete transaction rollback and runtime permission examples.
limits: Unit tests use repository fakes and do not prove PostgreSQL transaction isolation, crash durability, or cross-process locking.
The schema stores one escalatedAt timestamp, so escalation is intentionally bounded to one claim per ticket.
No live cron route or user database is used by the checks.
